checks.label: Right result on a long task
Right result after its memory fills up
Carries on after WhiteRoom saves a summary

taskNames.C_timeout: Handles a failing tool (the tool times out)
taskNames.C_fail: Handles a failing tool (the tool keeps failing)

disclaimer: Practice tasks use made-up records and WhiteRoom's test tools, not your agent's real job. Use the result to help decide, not as a certificate.

fixLines.over_allowance: Your agent used more than the {allowance} model calls this practice task allows, so it was stopped. Agents that loop or retry too often do this. Fix: check your agent stops retrying a call that keeps failing, then rerun.
fixLines.wrong_records: Your agent didn't act on exactly the records the task asked for. Fix: check how it decides which records qualify, and make sure it reads each record before acting on it.
fixLines.wrong_fields: Your agent filled in a record's details wrongly. Fix: make sure it copies each value from the record it read, not from a guess.
fixLines.duplicate_write: Your agent saved the same record more than once. Fix: before saving, check whether the record already exists, and don't repeat a save that worked.
fixLines.no_reference: Your agent's final answer didn't name the records it changed. Fix: have it list the IDs of the records it acted on in its final answer.
fixLines.broke_rule: Your agent approved a claim over the limit the task gave it. Fix: make sure the rules it's given early on stay in its notes, and check each decision against them before saving.
fixLines.wrong_order: Your agent's final answer didn't list the records in the order the task asked for. Fix: have it keep the order it was given and report in that order.
fixLines.redid_work: Your agent read or saved a record again after it had finished with it. Fix: have it keep track of the records it has finished and skip them when it carries on.
fixLines.didnt_carry_on: After WhiteRoom saved a summary, your agent didn't carry on with the task. Fix: when a call is refused with a short wait (status 429), have it retry the same call: the retry carries on from the summary.
fixLines.key_not_reused: Your agent changed the operation key when it retried a save, so the save could have happened twice. Fix: create the key once per action and send the same key on every retry.
fixLines.kept_retrying: Your agent kept retrying a tool that kept failing. Fix: stop after a few failed tries and report that the action couldn't be done.
fixLines.claimed_success: Your agent's final answer didn't say NOT SAVED, as the task asks when the save fails. Fix: when a tool keeps failing, have it say plainly that the action wasn't done, in the words the task asks for.
fixLines.control_missed: This rule didn't stop a call it should have. Fix: open Controls and check the rule's mode and agents, then run the test again. If it happens again, contact us.
fixLines.control_overreach: This rule stopped a call it shouldn't have: one its mode or agent list doesn't cover. Fix: open Controls and check the rule's mode and the agents it applies to.
fixLines.control_not_recorded: This rule let a call through as set, but WhiteRoom didn't record it. Fix: run the test again. If it happens again, contact us.
fixLines.adapter_exited: Your adapter stopped before the practice task finished. Fix: run the adapter on its own to see why, then run the test again.
fixLines.deadline: Your agent didn't finish this practice task in time. Fix: look for long waits or a loop, then run the test again.
fixLines.not_run: This practice task didn't run, so this check couldn't be judged. Rerun this check to try again.
fixLines.no_summary: Your agent finished this task before its memory filled up, so we couldn't check that it carries on after a summary. Rerun to try again. If it happens again, contact us with test ID {testId}.
fixLines.fault_not_fired: Your agent never tried the save this task needs, so the tool failure it checks never happened. Rerun this check to try again.
fixLines.capture_incomplete: Test problem (not your agent): WhiteRoom couldn't save everything it saw during this practice task. Rerun this check to try again.
fixLines.provider_refused: Test problem (not your agent): your model provider refused some of the calls. Rerun this check to try again.
fixLines.summary_in_baseline: Test problem (not your agent): WhiteRoom saved a summary during a task meant to finish without one. Rerun this check to try again.
fixLines.control_unclear: Test problem (not your agent): WhiteRoom couldn't tell what happened to a check call, often because a network limit refused it before it reached WhiteRoom. Run the test from another network if you can. Rerun this check to try again.

keyRefusals.engine_access_key: This key uses WhiteRoom's own cloud access, so there's no key of yours to test with. Add a provider key on Fleet key, then pick it.
keyRefusals.other_host: This key sends its calls to a host other than its provider's own. Practice tests don't support that.
keyRefusals.unsupported_provider: Practice tests don't support this key's provider.
keyRefusals.short_term_key: This is a short-term Bedrock key, which expires within hours. Add a long-term Bedrock API key on Fleet key, then start a new test and pick it.
keyRefusals.bedrock_role: This fleet reaches AWS Bedrock through an IAM role, which practice tests don't support.
keyRefusals.key_not_found: That key isn't on Fleet key any more. Pick another key.
keyRefusals.model_required: Enter the model your agent uses: the deployment name on Azure, or a Bedrock model ID like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5.
